name: Capture Nets
statusMeaning: In the catalogue, not checked yet.
author: kestalkayden
description: A reusable net that captures any passive or neutral mob — including modded ones — and releases them anywhere with full NBT preserved. Named pets, color variants, ages, and tame state all survive the trip.
evidence: Everything its code calls is covered by Kiln development build 2026-11-24 (73dc2fb1) (79 classes, 139 members). Not run yet.
